newsitem.title: USA: Weatherford mulls divestiture of some assets.
newsitem.headline: Weatherford mulls divestiture of some assets.

text.p: Weatherford Enterra Inc said Tuesday that it is exploring the divestiture of four businesses whose revenues amounted to $70 million, or 15 percent of the company's total revenues, during the first six months of 1996.

Weatherford said in a release Tuesday that following the sales of CRC-Evans Pipeline, Arrow Completion Systems, American Aero Cranes and Total Engineering Services Team, the company's business segments would consist of oilfield services, energy products and gas compression.
Weatherford added that it has hired Merrill Lynch & Co and Simmons & Co International to assist in the divestitures.
A spokesman for the company was not immediately available for comment.
